faqs.question: How long does a typical software project take from discovery to launch?
faqs.answer: Timelines vary based on complexity, but a modern MVP (Minimum Viable Product) typically spans 12 to 16 weeks. We utilize 2-week agile sprint cycles with continuous integration, allowing you to view progress and test feature builds in real-time.

faqs.question: How do you estimate project costs and structure billing?
faqs.answer: We offer both fixed-scope milestone pricing for defined MVPs and dedicated sprint team velocity billing for evolving platforms. Following a thorough technical discovery sprint, we provide a transparent cost breakdown with zero hidden overheads.

faqs.question: Do you work with high-growth startups as well as enterprises?
faqs.answer: Yes, our engineering model scales seamlessly. We partner with Series A+ startups requiring rapid, high-quality development to reach market fit, as well as Fortune 500 enterprises modernizing core legacy systems and cloud infrastructure.

faqs.question: Which modern tech stacks and cloud architectures do you specialize in?
faqs.answer: Our core stack emphasizes high performance and security: React, Next.js, and TypeScript on the frontend; Go, Node.js, and Python for services; paired with AWS/Azure serverless and Kubernetes orchestration.

faqs.question: Can your engineers seamlessly integrate into our existing internal team?
faqs.answer: Absolutely. Through our co-engineering model, our senior architects and developers embed directly into your Slack, Jira, and Git workflows. We emphasize pair programming, code reviews, and active knowledge transfer.

faqs.question: What happens after product launch? Do you provide ongoing support?
faqs.answer: Launch is just day one. We offer proactive maintenance, 24/7 uptime monitoring, performance optimization, and dedicated SLA contracts for continuous feature rollouts and infrastructure scalability.

faqs.question: How do you protect IP and handle Non-Disclosure Agreements?
faqs.answer: Intellectual property protection is legally enforced from day zero. We sign comprehensive bilateral NDAs before initial technical discovery, and 100% of code, documentation, and IP assets are transferred to your ownership.

faqs.question: What automated QA and security testing protocols do you enforce?
faqs.answer: We implement a Zero-Trust CI/CD pipeline. Every commit undergoes automated unit testing, end-to-end integration tests, SAST security vulnerability scanning, and peer code reviews prior to staging deployment.
